d: Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Ramayana: Rise of a Legend is witnessing a box-office paradox, delivering impressive global earnings while facing a sharp decline in theatrical screens in the US. The film has crossed $150 million worldwide, but is reportedly set to lose nearly 800 US theatres amid falling ticket sales. With a reported production budget of $200 million for the first instalment, questions remain over its commercial performance and profitability. The film's massive scale and global reach have put the spotlight on the economics of big-budget Indian cinema.
